{{Infobox instance|name=Ragefire Chasm|aka=RFC|ss=Ragefire chasm loading screen.png|caption=Ragefire Chasm loading graphic|loc=Under [[Orgrimmar]]|race={{RaceIcon|Tauren|Male}}|boss=[[Bazzalan]]|level=13-18|minlevel=|players=5|key=|bosses={{Ragefire Chasm}}}}'''Ragefire Chasm''' is a level 13-18 dungeon located in the Horde capital city of Orgrimmar. The instance portal is situated deep within the Cleft of Shadow. Due to its low-level requirement, straightforward progression path, and elementary mechanics, RFC is widely considered to be the easiest dungeon in the game.
